cohort: The study participants were 400 pregnant women, assessed at 16-18 weeks of gestation.
finding: The combination of uterine artery Doppler and serum Ang-2 levels at 16-18 weeks of gestation can predict early-onset preeclampsia but not overall preeclampsia, with abnormal results also indicating a higher risk for preterm delivery.
cross-section timing: Measurements were taken at 16-18 weeks of gestation.
